title.narrative: Enterprise Development and Investment Promotion (EDIP) Unit in the Bank of Khartoum, Republic of Sudan

description.narrative: The objective of the project is to promote inclusive industrial development in Sudan by supporting employment and income generating activities in the MSMEs sector, with a special focus on women. This will be achieved by strengthening the capacity of the Bank of Khartoum to deliver non-financial services and financial products to potential and existing entrepreneurs willing to translate their business ideas into concrete businesses (start-ups) or grow and expand their existing enterprises. The project envisages the establishment of a non-financial #Enterprise Development <(>&<)> Investment Promotion# (EDIP) Unit within the Bank of Khartoum to deliver a variety of non-financial services to potential and existing entrepreneurs in order to build and strengthen their entrepreneurial and business skills to start or grow a business, appropriate to her/his competencies and background. The mobilization of these domestic investments is expected to leverage the flow of foreign investment in the country, to promote the transition of existing and potential micro enterprises into small and eventually medium enterprises and their migration from the informal to the formal sector, thus contributing to job creation and to an increased diversification of the local economy.
